Synopsis:
The August 2026 Ifo business climate index beat expectations, rising to 88.8 from 86.7 in July, signalling a broadening economic recovery in Germany. Q2 2026 GDP was revised up to +0.3% QoQ. Business sentiment improved across all sectors. Notably, the Ifo president flagged that energy prices have risen again, even as the economy recovers.
